kind: static exact combined-source fixture preparation; nothing seeded or launched
launch: Only after root releases this exact full-review worker: use /workspace/nevora-inspection-runtime/launch-before-listen.sh, READY_REVIEW_RELEASED_SHA matching checkpoint, PREVIEW_OWNER=phase3-full, owned disk PREVIEW_OUT, and phase3OwnEntryExtension environment below. dates.fixtureDate: Read actual audit.fixtureDate; do not hardcode the calendar day
dates.availabilityNextWeek: Read audit.nextWeekSeeded, verify it equals fixtureWeek plus7days

withdraw.confirmation: Open the first owned pending withdrawal disclosure; Enter must be on its action button, not its checkbox

decidedTimeOff.proof: Extra fixture supplies approved/partial/declined/withdrawn rows without any browser action

onBreak.proof: Exact source extra fixture uses existing owned Clocker device and real open fictional entries

payStatements.proof: Verify under current browser session; fixture creation alone is not visible-proof closure

updates.uuid: Resolve the owned fictional required-ack update from a.updates-row/API result; never hardcode a prior preview UUID
updates.title: Fictional inspection schedule update
updates.businessWrites: Every acknowledge/send/mark-read/withdraw/rotate/revoke/Save action held or fulfilled locally

large.timeEntries: One year of weekdays for AUDIT-E and ten large-data people
large.proof: Verify intended location and displayed data, not just a seed count

ignoredDependencyLink.rule: Ignored source link only; approved launcher must dereference physical node_modules inside owned Turbopack mirror. No app files changed.

phase3OwnEntryExtension.slot: After exact-source seed-extra/templates; before communication publication/listen; exclusive with supplemental Payroll fixture
phase3OwnEntryExtension.canonicalReadback: Both own time and correction context must confirm real entry+break targets before listen

withdrawalPrerequisites.method: Exact-source createTimeOffRequest + getTimeOffRequest + parseWithdrawalCommand; real own pending UUIDv4 per actor, reusing a suitable existing one if present
withdrawalPrerequisites.legacyFixtureReason: audit-timeoff non-UUID fails current parseWithdrawalCommand, Lead original fixture has only approved request

nativeActionProtocolPrerequisite.completionRule: Only an actually intercepted same-origin native POST fulfilled locally, then real rendered decided UI plus expected focus. Neither arbitrary JSON nor this static wire description is a pass. Missed interception/unsupported body is a setup gap. Actual decided UI with wrong focus is a measured product failure, not a fixture gap.
